connector.name: Send16 MCP
connector.registryDescription: Email for AI agents: send mail, manage contacts, automations & webhooks. Zero-DNS first send.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.send16.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package send16-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the spruikco account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
